polymarket_global.name: Polymarket (international, polymarket.com)
polymarket_global.formula: fee = C × feeRate × p × (1 − p); only takers pay; C = shares, p = share price

rounding.note: Fees are rounded to 5 decimals (minimum 0.00001 USDC).

notes: Some series differ from the category rate (for example NFL and college football markets at 0.03 in November 2026); each market's feeSchedule is authoritative.
Fees apply only to markets created after their category's activation date; older markets can be fee-free.

schedule.summary: New category coefficients, new taker rebate tiers (Bronze and Silver removed, Onyx added, no category multipliers) and tiered maker rebates instead of the daily market-wide rebate pools.

rate_labels.Sports: All sports, including NFL and college football

schedule.weighted_volume: Each fill adds shares × price × (1 − price); a tier uses the sum over the last 30 days. Taker fills count only toward the taker tier, maker fills only toward the maker tier. No category multipliers.
schedule.taker_rebate_basis: share of the taker fees you paid
schedule.maker_rebate_basis: share of the taker fees generated by your eligible maker fills
notes: Makers continue to pay no platform trading fee.
Combos keep their own coefficient regardless of the categories of their legs and earn no maker rebates; fee-free trades earn no maker rebates either.
One-time level-up bonuses end; liquidity rewards are unchanged.
Each market's own feeSchedule is authoritative.

polymarket_us.name: Polymarket US (CFTC-regulated app)
polymarket_us.formula: fee = Θ × C × p × (1 − p), one curve for all markets

rounding.note: Rounded to the nearest $0.01 with banker's rounding (half to even).

polymarket_us.makers: no fee on standard markets; maker rebates start from $10 million in maker volume. Combo makers pay 0.03 × C × p × (1 − p) (not modelled)
notes: Combo fees (not modelled in the calculator): taker fee = C × p × [Θ × (1 − p) + 0.06 × (1 − p)^4] since 2026-11-11 13:00 ET (before: C × p × [0.0695 × (1 − p) + 0.085 × (1 − p)^4]), with Θ the account's taker coefficient; combo maker fee = 0.03 × C × p × (1 − p), and combo fills carry no maker rebate. Source: docs.polymarket.us/fees (seen 2026-11-15).

kalshi.name: Kalshi
kalshi.formula: taker fee = round up(M × 0.07 × C × P × (1 − P)), M = 1 by default; maker fee = round up(M × 0.0175 × C × P × (1 − P)), M = 0 by default (only series listed with maker fees). Round up: fee + position cost (C × P) is rounded up to a whole centicent ($0.0001)

rounding.note: Kalshi rounds the fee up so that fee plus position cost (contracts × price) is a whole centicent ($0.0001), per the fee schedule (7.7.26, p. 2). Accounts cleared through a broker (FCM) keep balances in whole cents, so there the fee rounds to the cent.

notes: M is a per-series multiplier (1, 0.5 or 0); default 1 for taker fees, 0 for maker fees.
